items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: And I said, Captain Henry, Willie Almeyford, and then, he was saying, I think Lewis Gibbons was saying

ctx.x: So, I said, well, I'll tell you the fact that, sir, I'm not going to play no drums for no dollar a night. I mean, nothing, I'm not knowing something, you know? But that's all, that's all there was, really, because she made money now. I said, I ain't, I wouldn't play no drums for no dollar a night. He said, well, I can get a dollar in Coraline. I said, no. I said, well, I mean, daughter was a friend of mine, he had a wife, he was real chewing, you know? I said, I can do this house, and get my money, and buy food…
